frontiers.selection_note: Default = cheapest ranked member (econ-style lexicographic). Capability-order would pick the LLM baseline gpt-5.6-luna at ~10x the $/1k. system-one-open is JevBench's calibration counterexample (Cal 54.9); members are the Pareto set.
frontiers.source_note: Axes from JevBench v1.4.2 ranked board (github.com/fstandhartinger/jevbench, MIT; benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models), read 2026-09-29: capability = mean(JevBench Intelligence, JevBench Calibration) on the 1,624-decision 904-public + 720-sealed protocol (chance-corrected tier-weighted accuracy + hard-tier ECE); cost = JevBench measured/announced/estimated $ per 1,000 decisions (basis carried per row). Board ses published sealed aggregates only; public->sealed accuracy gap >25pp flagged (contamination guard). Lichen (github.com/Mushroom-Systems/lichen) and Jeff (github.com/firelex/jeff) remain discovery-tagged but off-board: JevBench has no Lichen/Jeff rows in v1.4.2; ollaya.dev-re-hosted measurements required before admission. Re-measure everything through the JevBench harness, never Ollaya's own numbers.
